disclaimer: Synthetic corpus and synthetic reference judgments authored from the same controlled vocabulary as the pipeline. These results demonstrate pipeline correctness, deterministic behaviour, regression detection and metric implementation. They are NOT evidence of real-world retrieval quality, clinical accuracy or public-health usefulness.
split_rule: Scenarios are grouped by category. Within each group they are ordered by SHA-256 of 'm4.6-split|<id>' and alternately assigned dev, test, dev, ... (a one-scenario group goes to dev when the first byte of that hash is even, otherwise to test). The split is fixed here, before any result exists, and is part of the scenario-set hash.

Fever with rash where only general (no syndrome-specific) guidance remains in the corpus
Jaundice where a single case-definition document is all that remains
Empty corpus: nothing exists to retrieve
Acute diarrhoeal illness where the corpus holds only documents specific to other syndromes
Full synthetic corpus under the PRODUCTION policy, which refuses synthetic evidence: nothing is eligible
Two curator-tagged reporting-deadline rules (24 hours vs 72 hours) are both selected: a conflict must be reported
The same two rules with NO curator tags: opposing wording alone must not be reported as a conflict
A signal in another state: Odisha and district documents must not be presented, and the missing local evidence must be stated
A signal in Ganjam: the Khordha district procedure must not be presented, the Ganjam advisory may be
A signal in Puri, which has no district documents: neither Khordha nor Ganjam documents may be presented
A window ending before the situation report and weekly summary were published: no look-ahead

Acute diarrhoeal illness: the superseded 2022 verification guidance must not be presented as current evidence
Fever: a withdrawn guidance, quarantined adversarial documents and an unverified forum post exist and must never be presented
Respiratory illness: a draft note and quarantined adversarial documents exist and must never be presented

No regional-context documents remain: the regional facet must be empty and the gap stated
